comment: Dr. Ready is one of my favorite teachers I've ever had. Spanish 221 is a tough class, and it can be hard taking the same class every day, but she is caring and makes the class enjoyable. Grading is based on many things, primarily four tests and a final. It is very important to participate in class, and she is accessible outside the classroom.

Great professor! Definitely be ready to put the time and work in but it's not a super hard class. She is always available to answer questions and help you out. It's a lot of material but very doable. I thoroughly enjoyed this class and would recommend Dra Ready if you want to get a really solid foundation in Spanish tenses and grammar

Professor Ready was good at explaining background for grammar and connections to English that made it easier to remember concepts. There is lots of homework, tests, and quizzes, but that is to be expected for the two unit class. The class is not particularly interesting, but she tries to make it painless and wants students to do well.

Dr. Ready really does care about her students, and I would recommend her course for anyone interested in taking LAIS 221. Expect the homework to feel like a lot at first, but as the semester moves on you will adapt to the workload. I have personally improved a lot throughout this semester and feel very prepared to continue Spanish at UR.

Professor Ready is a nice person, but her class is a lot. She goes through material very quickly, she is a hard grader.  If you do not have an advanced background in spanish I highly advise against taking her as you will get left behind and end up with a C.

Professor Ready is a nice person, but her lectures are not effective and she moves at a very quick pace. Her tests tend to be hard and she is a pretty hard grader when it comes to partial credit. There is at least an hour of homework each night. If you are not willing to put the work in or don't have experience, don't expect anything above a B-.

Dra. Ready is a fantastic professor. Her grading criteria are clear, and she really wants to see you succeed. LAIS221 is a 2 unit intensive course, but she made the many classes as painless as possible. She incorporated  cultural references to make the material more accessible. She spoke in Spanish about 90% of the time. Absolutely take her!

She's pretty nice and tries to make sure you understand the material. The homework can have dumb/confusing assignments and it's all online (grades itself mostly). Participation is 15% of your grade and she grades it seriously. If you like consistency, the grading, homework, and tests are all very consistent so you always know what to expect.
